mapper.select: SELECT pv.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity)::INTEGER AS sold_quantity_1m FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_code = oi.product_code JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id WHERE o.order_datetime >= #{sinceAt} AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' AND p.sale_start_at <= #{asOf} AND (p.sale_end_at IS NULL OR p.sale_end_at > #{asOf}) GROUP BY pv.product_id ORDER BY sold_quantity_1m DESC, pv.product_id ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popular_product_rankings ( ranking_date, rank, product_id, sold_quantity_1m, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{rankingDate}, #{rank}, #{productId}, #{soldQuantity1m}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, pv.product_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_code = oi.product_code WHERE o.order_datetime >= #{sinceAt} AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, pv.product_id ORDER BY o.order_id ASC, pv.product_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommended_related_products ( recommendation_date, source_product_id, rank, recommended_product_id, score, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{recommendationDate}, #{sourceProductId}, #{rank}, #{recommendedProductId}, #{score}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
